stem_book: A simple pendulum of length 1 m has a wooden bob of mass 1 kg. It is struck by a bullet of mass 10^(−2) kg moving with a speed of 2×10² m s⁻¹. The bullet gets embedded into the bob. The height to which the bob rises before swinging back is (use g = 10 m s⁻²) (a) 0.30 m (b) 0.20 m (c) 0.35 m (d) 0.40 m
